messages:
maria: Hey team — we need a GCP quota bump in europe-north1 for a staging GPU pool. Requesting the following increases for project redwood-staging-eun1 (project number: 987654321012): A100 (v4) GPUs: +8, H100 GPUs: +4, L4 GPUs: +12. Also need external static IP quota from 20 -> 60 and regional egress throughput to 2 Gbps. Purpose: dedicated staging pool for perf tests and internal evals, will be mostly preemptible but we need a handful of on-demand H100 for low-latency regressions. Can someone approve or open the support case? :rocket:

sam: Can you paste the billing account and the cost center code? Also rough monthly hours estimate so finance can pre-approve.

maria: Billing account: 0012-ABCD-3456. Cost center: eng-infra-staging. Estimate: if fully utilized ~ 3200 GPU-hours/month (mixed); rough cost ~$12k/month (preemptible-heavy).

ben: Are you planning to use preemptible/spot for A100/L4 only? H100 on-demand? We should request quotas for both preemptible and standard just in case quotas are separate in quota UI.

maria: Yes — A100/L4 will be spot/preemptible, H100 will be on-demand. We want both quotas increased. I checked current quotas with this: 
```
gcloud compute regions describe europe-north1 --project=redwood-staging-eun1 --format="json(quotas)"
```
Current GPU quotas show small headroom so need the bump before next week's load tests.

kristen: Security note: ensure the staging VPC (vpc-staging-eun1) has Private Google Access enabled and the firewall rules to restrict SSH/RDP to jump hosts. Also confirm service account used to create instances has no broad role like owner. Who will submit the case?

maria: Confirmed: vpc-staging-eun1 has Private Google Access and restricted firewall tags, jump-host bastion is in the same subnet. Service account: infra-gpu-provisioner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com with Compute Admin + restricted iam roles. I can open the case unless infra team prefers to.

sam: If you open it, include this text as the justification and request a regional quota for both preemptible and standard GPUs. Also ask them to increase the "Static External IP addresses" quota from 20 to 60 and "Regional (All) Networking Egress" to 2000 Mbps.

maria: Opening now...

infra-bot: Support case created: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/123456789 (case# 123456789) — status: NEW. Assigned to GCP support.

ops-oncall: +1 to the request. Can we canary first? Start with 2 A100 + 1 H100 in the pool, run perf jobs for 48h, then scale to full size if OK. Also tag all VMs with billing:eng-infra-staging so costs are tracked.

maria: Good plan. I'll request the canary in the ticket and include the tag. If GCP says capacity constrained we can fallback to us-west1 temporarily. I'll update this thread when the quota is approved or GCP asks for more info. :thumbsup:

sam: Thx — please paste the support case link here once you have it (infra-bot did) and set a follow-up reminder for 72h.

maria: Will do. Case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/123456789 — follow-up set.

infra-bot: GCP replied: "Request more info: please provide peak concurrent cores/GPUs per VM and example machine types."

maria: Replying with: A100 VMs: a2-highgpu-1g (1x A100) and a2-megagpu-16g (16x) for scale tests, H100 will be n2-highgpu-4 (4x H100) for low-latency path, and L4 will be t4-like or l4-specific machine with 1-4 GPUs per VM. Concurrent peak ~ 40 GPUs across pool for staging test.

ben: Nice, include that some workloads are ephemeral and will auto-drain on preemption, we don't need capacity guarantees beyond the requested quota.

maria: Added. Waiting on GCP.

ops-oncall: If approved, please create a short runbook for provisioning and teardown of the staging pool and hand off to oncall.

maria: Will write the runbook and link it here once the quota is in.

infra-bot: Update: case# 123456789 updated to PENDING_ACTION (GCP asked for billing verification).

maria: Pinged finance to confirm billing details to expedite. Updates soon.
